title: Amma's (Jan's) Strawberry Shortcake
description: A classic strawberry shortcake with tender biscuit-like layers, sweet macerated strawberries, and whipped cream.

steps.instruction: Hull and slice strawberries, then mix with sugar and half-and-half. Set aside to macerate.
In a large bowl, sift together flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, and baking soda.
Cut shortening into the dry ingredients until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Add buttermilk and gently stir until just combined (do not overmix).
Divide dough into two pie pans and gently pat into 1-inch thick rounds.
Bake for about 10 minutes, until lightly golden.
Serve shortcake topped with macerated strawberries and whipped cream.
